characters.name: Arthur Finch
characters.goal: save eight hundred pounds to leave the city for Leeds

characters.name: Julian Ward
characters.goal: endure the isolated night shifts without losing his mind

characters.name: Martin Finch
characters.goal: secure Arthur's deposit money for the Leeds workshop lease

characters.name: Kieran Doyle

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Establishes Arthur's secret savings stash and the strict enforcement of building lockouts.
required_beats: Arthur counts his cash envelope and hides it deep inside locker 44 before the warning bell rings.
Henderson enters the locker room to order all day staff out ahead of the electronic security locks engaging.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Introduces the threat of locker inspections that puts Arthur's hidden savings in jeopardy.
required_beats: Julian works alone unloading oxygen canisters in the freezing loading bay wind.
Henderson warns Julian that friday dawn locker sweeps will confiscate any unapproved personal property.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Escalates financial pressure on Arthur by setting a hard deadline to produce the workshop deposit.
required_beats: Martin corners Arthur in the basement demanding eight hundred pounds before January first.
Arthur tucks his money behind the locker vent as the heating flue begins its evening rattle.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Provides Arthur with a false sense of romantic hope amid his mounting despair.
required_beats: Arthur finds an unsigned romantic card on his shelf inside locker 44 and assumes it is sincere affection from a colleague.
Worn down by Martin's demands, Arthur writes an earnest response expressing his dread of dying in the hospital basements.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To turn a cruel workplace prank into a protective secret correspondence by leveraging Kieran's illicit stash.
required_beats: Julian intercepts Arthur's tender letter from locker 44 and is deeply moved by its vulnerability.
Catching Kieran storing stolen pharmacy ethanol in the boiler room, Julian blackmails him into abandoning the prank and staying away from Arthur.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To commit Julian to a sincere correspondence founded on a hidden lie.
required_beats: Julian deposits the blue notebook containing his own thoughtful prose onto the upper shelf of locker 44.
Fearful that the truth would crush Arthur, Julian decides to conceal that the correspondence originated as Kieran's spiteful dare.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To establish Arthur's deep emotional investment and his romanticized misconceptions about his correspondent.
required_beats: At shift start, Arthur reads the entries and pours his private hopes into the notebook.
From the erudite tone of the letters, Arthur concludes his pen pal must be an unattached, scholarly clerk with no roots.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To expose the familial burdens anchoring Julian to the hospital during a crisis.
required_beats: Heavy snowfall seals the hospital loading dock, trapping the night staff inside for double shifts.
Between supply runs, Julian slips away to visit his bedridden uncle in the palliative annex, weighed down by his care duties.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Arthur risks exposure by intercepting the correspondence just before Henderson can discover and confiscate it.
required_beats: Henderson begins his Friday dawn inspection, searching lockers and seizing unauthorized items.
Arthur pulls the blue notebook from locker 44 and conceals it beneath his uniform right as Henderson reaches him.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: A misheard conversation shatters Arthur's faith in the correspondence and turns his hope into humiliation.
required_beats: Arthur retreats into the boiler room corridor and hears Kieran laughing with Julian through an open ventilation flue.
Overhearing Kieran talk about 'the joke in locker 44,' Arthur realizes Julian must have been mocking him the entire time.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Arthur commits to a direct confrontation, trapping himself inside the facility and escalating the stakes with security.
required_beats: What pushes this decision now, staged first: Arthur overhears Julian and Kieran arguing through the boiler flue, misinterpreting their talk as mockery.
Determined to confront the note writer face-to-face, Arthur refuses to leave at the end of his shift.
The automated 19:00 deadbolts engage, trapping Arthur in the basement while Henderson sounds the breach alarm.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Arthur learns the cruel origin of the correspondence before Julian redeems it by confessing the sincerity of his feelings.
required_beats: Arthur enters the loading bay and encounters Kieran, who spitefully reveals that the first note began as a wager to bait a fool.
Julian arrives on the ramp just as Arthur throws the blue notebook onto the frozen asphalt.
Julian confesses that he took over writing every reply after the initial card because Arthur's words made him feel human again.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To sever Arthur's ties to Martin's business and commit him to remaining in the city.

char_arthur.goal: save eight hundred pounds to leave the city for Leeds
remain in the city and meet Julian on honest terms

required_beats: Arthur retrieves the battered notebook from the frozen slush of the ramp and rereads Julian's honest admissions.
In the supervisor's office, Martin demands Arthur sign the partnership contract before the New Year deadline expires.
Realizing Martin's joyless enterprise would only trade one servitude for another, Arthur hands Martin five hundred pounds as a gift and refuses to sign the Leeds lease.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To strip away the fantasy of escape and establish the unvarnished terms of Arthur and Julian's bond.
required_beats: In the boiler room, Arthur tells Julian he has abandoned the Leeds partnership to remain in the city.
Julian warns Arthur that his duty to his dying uncle prevents him from ever offering an easy or romantic escape.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To culminate their quiet courtship into an open, grounded partnership in the real world.
required_beats: Arthur and Julian return to Locker 44 together as the morning shift bells ring.
Setting aside the notebook, they share a thermos of tea in person to face the hospital together.

voice_card.narrative_distance: omniscient and openly amused, willing to address the reader
voice_card.register: light, digressive, fond of its own asides
voice_card.sentence_rhythm: springy sentences with parenthetical swerves; frequent dashes
voice_card.dialogue_density: high; characters talk over each other and the narrator enjoys it
voice_card.reader_familiarity: The first time a deep term appears (domain-specific jargon), let dialogue or narration make its meaning clear within a clause. Never lecture.

metadata.title: The Locker Below St. Jude's
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

facts.statement: Locker 44 in the basement is allocated jointly to day porter Arthur Finch and night porter Julian Ward.
Kieran Doyle planted the initial romantic card in Locker 44 as a workplace prank to mock Arthur Finch's reclusiveness.
Julian Ward answered Arthur's vulnerable reply under a pen name to protect him from Kieran's locker-room mockery.
Arthur Finch has saved eight hundred pounds in cash to purchase a half-share in Martin's Leeds joinery workshop.
Hospital security regulations mandate that electronic basement doors deadbolt automatically at 07:00 and 19:00 to prevent shift overlap.
Supervisor Henderson inspects all basement porter lockers for contraband and shift infractions every Friday at dawn.
An acoustic draft through the ventilation flue behind Locker 44 transmits audible conversations directly into the boiler room.
Martin Finch will sell the Leeds joinery lease to an external buyer unless Arthur delivers eight hundred pounds by New Year's Eve.
Julian Ward discovered Kieran Doyle hiding stolen pharmacy ethanol, giving Julian leverage to force Kieran's silence.
Julian Ward is anchored to the city hospital because he provides daily palliative support to his bedridden uncle in the annex.

premise.logline: Two hospital porters on opposite shifts fall for each other through notes left in a shared locker, and one of them is not who the notes suggest.

modules.theme: whether you can love someone you have only ever read
modules.setting_time: a hard winter of staff shortages
modules.setting_place: a large city hospital, its basements and loading bays
modules.protagonist: a day porter saving to leave the city
modules.protagonist_want: to meet the night porter without ruining it
modules.antagonism: a rota that never lets them overlap, and a supervisor who reads the notes
modules.complication: the notes were started by someone else, as a joke
modules.ending_shape: they meet as themselves and choose each other anyway

plot_shape.name: Courtship
plot_shape.central_question: What has to be given up for these two to be honest with each other?

phases.name: Two worlds
phases.purpose: Both parties established separately, each with a commitment in the way.

phases.name: Collision
phases.purpose: Forced proximity; a misjudgement each makes about the other.

phases.name: Concealment
phases.purpose: Something true is withheld, for a reason that is not cowardice.

phases.name: Exposure
phases.purpose: The withheld thing surfaces at the worst available moment.

phases.name: Terms
phases.purpose: What each actually gives up, stated plainly.

cast_roles.purpose: Withholds something, and has a good reason.
A person embodying what one of them owes elsewhere.
Knows the withheld thing and is bound not to say it.

obligatory_moves: The reader learns the withheld thing before the second party does.
The misjudgement is reasonable given what that character has been shown.
Neither party gets what they wanted without naming what it costs.
